# ARVREL

> ARVREL is an open-source, vendor-neutral IEC 61850 Sampled Values virtual protection relay laboratory for process-bus analysis, feeder protection, PCAP replay, phasor analysis, trust gating, and reviewable engineering evidence.

Canonical product site: https://masarray.github.io/arvrel/
Source repository: https://github.com/masarray/arvrel
Official releases: https://github.com/masarray/arvrel/releases
License: GPL-3.0-or-later

## Current product boundary

ARVREL is virtual-output laboratory software. Virtual output only: it does not provide physical relay contacts, operational GOOSE trip, MMS control, autonomous switching, switching authority, calibrated test-set evidence, IEC 61850 conformance certification, IEC 60255 type-test evidence, or hard-real-time guarantees.

The release page is the package source of truth. Features on the main development branch become official packaged capabilities only after a versioned release publishes the corresponding artifacts and integrity metadata.
